evidence.quote: if not books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Drafts.IsEmpty || not books.Books.Invoices.IsEmpty || not books.Payments.IsEmpty then

ARC-REV-01.rationale: Every new rule is in Tier 2. Transfer.fs in Summa.Storage decides the file format and the refusal order, and runs the book checks. The engine's apply function decides when an import is allowed: new books only, not on GitHub, files pack required. The engine also decides the download name and the notice text. The Tier 3 wire only maps three event names to messages and makes no decision.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: Transfer is documented as pure. The export time comes from ctx.Now in the engine (`Transfer.export manifest books ctx.Now`). The download leaves as an OfferDownload effect, and the save as the existing `save` effect, so the Tier 4 edge carries both out. The change adds no clock, I/O or console use below Tier 4.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The schema name, version, classification (`Exports.Classification`) and data version (`Exports.dataVersion`) each have one definition. The same timestamp format pattern is written out twice, once to write and once to parse. The copies agree, but nothing ties them together, so they could drift. The `yyyy-MM-dd` date format is also written in several places.

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The version 2 contents check is in Tier 2 Transfer.read, and `contentsOf` counts the books there. The preview in the Tier 2 engine calls `Transfer.read`, the same checks as the import, and only formats the counts into a sentence. The Tier 3 wire is unchanged and re-derives nothing.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: All new code is pure: `contentsOf`, the contents parsing and comparison, and `booksTransferPreview`. It adds no clock, I/O or persistence below Tier 4. The preview is a pure projection of the model's text into a view value.

evidence.quote: | Error why -> $"This file cannot be imported: {why}"

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The counts have one definition, `contentsOf`, used by export, read and the preview. The accepted versions are named by `Version` and `FirstVersion`. The sentence 'This file cannot be imported: …' is now written in both the preview and the import handler, and the copies agree. The timestamp format pattern also still appears twice in Transfer.fs, as in change set 1. Neither copy contradicts the other.
